nom: TONYMOLY Green Tea Superlight Daily Defense Sun Screen SPF 50

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: several say it wears well and controls shine or gives a non-oily dewy finish, while others report it oozes, needs powder, or is generally too oily/greasy for very oily or oily-acne-prone skin.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers consistently describe it as hydrating, moisturizing and soothing, with one suggesting the formula suits drier skin better than very oily skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are mixed: some find it too greasy or thick and better suited to drier skin, while others say it controls oil well, doesn't clog pores, and works nicely on their T-zone.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report it as calming, non-irritating and safe under makeup, though a few sensitive reviewers experienced eye stinging, redness, bumps or an allergic reaction.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically discuss mature skin.

concerns.aging: No reviewer discusses anti-aging effects specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers describe the formula as hydrating, moisturizing, dewy and calming for dry or dehydrated skin; no dissent reported on this point.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the product left her face extremely red, hot and bumpy (allergic reaction), while another with sensitive skin reports no redness at all.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention eye stinging/watering or burning attributed to sunscreen-filter sensitivity, described as a personal reactivity issue rather than universal; most others report no stinging or irritation.
concerns.spots: Not directly addressed; reviewers discuss breakouts (see blemishes) rather than dark spots or pigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with acne-prone or oily skin, report no new breakouts and even improved skin feel; however multiple reviewers describe sudden or repeated breakouts, including one severe case, after use.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers say it is non-greasy, mattifying or gives a dewy (not oily) finish even on oily skin; several others explicitly say it is too oily, greasy or requires powder, especially for very oily or combination skin.

extraits.titre: Horrible breakout but I really wanted to love it
extraits.texte: I started using this sunscreen a couple of months ago & initially had no issues but its started breaking my face out really badly all of a sudden :( it also does it when it put it on my neck or chest. Up until the breakout, it was my new fave, ironically, so thinking its just suited best for people that dont have sensitive and/or oily skin. Despite the name, there is no green tea fragrance but it does have a very mild sunscreen scent that is pleasant.

Price point is great, but if you have extremely oily skin like I do, stay far away. If I were not wearing makeup, this would be… fine, but I had to dab my face, then powder it before applying makeup because the residue was oozing. This would probably be best for someone with much drier skin.
It's not a bad sunscreen, it's good for sensitive skin but it's a little bit too oily for my combo skin. I would recommend but not for anyone with combo/oily acne prone skin.
I really wanted to like this suncreen. I loved the way it felt but left my face extremely red and bumps. And very hot.

I have dry and slightly senstive skin. My pores clog easily. I previosuky have been using La Rosche Posay face sunscreen (and have tried many others). This is my favorite i have tried. Price is great, is slightly hydrating, no strong white cast, and thin enough to not make my face feel greasy or clogged. I love it also has skincare properties in it. Definitley a must try if youre looking for a good everyday face sunscreen!

extraits.titre: the BEST sunscreen I have ever used
extraits.texte: I have combo skin and all the sunscreens I have used made me feel so oily! They have exemplified the oil on my forehead especially! I used this tonymoly one for the first time and it does not make my forehead super oily or any other areas. It also doubles as a makeup primer which is really cool. I bought this on sale and I would definitely buy this again!

extraits.titre: Perfect, everyday sunscreen for sensitive, acne-prone skin
extraits.texte: Super lightweight, hydrating formula that gives a natural, radiant glow without the greasiness and stickiness. Blends seamlessly with no white cast! It has a slight sunscreen fragrance that dissipates after a while.
